name: B10-0524/2026 (S&D) – Le cas de Paata Burchuladze et des prisonniers politiques sous le régime du parti Rêve géorgien
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Georgia. It condemns the seven-year prison sentence given to opera singer and democracy activist Paata Burchuladze, calling it politically motivated. It asks Georgia to release all political prisoners, stop using restrictive laws against peaceful protest, and return to democratic reforms. It also asks the European Union to ban visas for Georgian officials responsible for repression and to give more support to Georgian civil society and independent media.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and calls for action.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, detained protesters and activists, and EU visa policy.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU institutions and Georgia's authorities. Follow-up depends on them.
